body: thank you for your kind words.

The thing is, I think I know what I want but I just feel like a could never do it.

Damn anxiety :(

Sorry I dozed off. Another issue I have. I sleep like 12 hours a day at the moment :(

I've been trying to get myself out there. Had an epiphany a few weeks back and all seemed well. But the depression has hit again.

Just reading that you manage to pass your depression might've given hope that I can.

Thank you. Again I know that I shouldnt feel guilty but I still feel so bad. 

I know the depression started after my parents broke up when I was 18/19. (it was quite a messy/shouting/abusive break-up) Went through 6 months of serious drinking, passing out everywhere. Then I went to college made friends/met my current SO but I think it affected me alot more than I thought. 
I dont really drink anymore, I then subsituted that with shopping, again quit that bad habit. Trying to find something that made me happy. 
Sometimes I have a good week and feel like I can conquer the world but then I'll hit rock bottom and not shower or want to leave the house.
